cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I haven't booked our anniversary trip. Can you hear why before you get your laptop?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help with the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I let you think that. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the laptop shut. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can you still sit beside me while I explain?
